item.title: Diffusion in one paragraph
item.description: An image diffusion model learns one skill: given a noisy image, predict the noise in it. During training, it takes real images, adds a random amount of noise, and learns to predict exactly what was added. To draw something new, you start from pure noise. At each step the model predicts the noise, and a sampler uses that prediction to make the image a little cleaner. After 20 to 1,000 such steps an image appears. A text-to-image model also reads your prompt at every step, so the cleaned-up image matches the prompt. The terms below name each piece.
